reason: At base, Y{1,4} regex matches Y and YYY but implementation only handles YY/YYYY, so unsupported tokens fall through to timezone offset fallback producing "+0000" instead of literal "Y" or "24Y".
PR fixes regex to only match YYYY/YY and preserves unsupported tokens literally. Test now gets expected behavior: single Y returns "Y", YYY returns year+"Y".
Base code checks param.indexOf("%") and decodes if present. %20 is correctly decoded to space character.
Refactor extracts tryDecodeURIComponent utility but preserves the decoding logic. Percent-encoded parameters still decoded correctly.
PR description explicitly states @score is not updated after reschedule at base. Reading entry.score returns stale value, not the new reschedule time.
Fix adds @score = at.to_f after zincrby. In-memory entry now reflects new reschedule time immediately, test assertions on entry.score and entry.at pass.
Test is about Content-Type parsing with charset parameter, PR modifies Range header handling. These are unrelated; Content-Type parsing is standard HTTP functionality.
Range header PR does not affect Content-Type parsing code. Test behavior unchanged from base.
Test about zip file timestamp preservation; PR is about logging messages. These are unrelated. Timestamp preservation is established functionality.
Logging improvement PR does not affect zip timestamp handling. Multiple re-archiving operations still produce consistent source-matching timestamps.
Test about JSON async deserialization; PR modifies CredentialCacheKey path comparison. These are unrelated; JSON deserialization is core functionality.
CredentialCacheKey changes do not affect JSON deserialization behavior. Sync and async deserialization still produce equivalent results.
Test title suggests INET subnet comparison with <<=ANY. PR fixes FETCH FIRST on empty WITH HOLD cursor. If unrelated, should pass. Confidence lowered due to unclear connection.
Test behavior should be unchanged if FETCH FIRST fix does not affect INET comparison logic. Without clear connection between test and PR, assume functionality is separate.
PR fixes NO_PROXY to support IPv4/IPv6. Test likely fails at base because NO_PROXY does not properly handle IP addresses before the fix.
After PR applies fix to NO_PROXY IPv4/IPv6 support, client construction with IP addresses in NO_PROXY succeeds.
PR title indicates bug in Series.str.match with regex flags. Test likely fails at base when matching string column with specific regex flag pattern.
After BUG fix for Series.str.match regex flag handling, matching string column against pattern with flag succeeds.
PR fixes recursive result parents on groups in middle of chain. Test likely fails at base when serializing async results with this structure.
After fix to recursive result parents, async result serialization in two-segment chain with middle group works correctly.
PR title indicates value_terminator has no effect when first argument. Test likely fails at base when trailing double-dash should hand off with value_terminator.
After fixing value_terminator behavior as first argument, trailing double-dash correctly hands off to later arguments.
PR removes compile-time dependency on derived modules. Test likely fails at base if required field validation depends on module loading at compile time.
After removing compile-time module dependency, required field validation works without module load, test passes.
The test expects OptionSet NOT to fire from OSC 11, but the code uses nvim_set_option_value which triggers autocommands. This matches the documented test failure in the PR.
The fix uses vim.cmd("noautocmd set background=...") to suppress OptionSet autocommands as intended, satisfying the test expectation that OSC 11 should not trigger OptionSet.
